archetype: Organic & Earthy + Swiss Precision (Enterprise ESG Compliance)

core_principles: Tactical ESG Precision: Sharp structural grids with high data density that instills audit-grade confidence
Organic Grounding: Earthy forest emerald accents paired with deep charcoal slates and crisp bone neutrals
Immutable Transparency: Distinct visual emphasis on audit trails, LEI identifiers, and verification badges
Zero Visual Monotony: High-contrast typography pairing, micro-interactions, and clear status visual hierarchy
forbidden_elements: Teal blue / Teal green #1B93A4 (Forbidden dashboard color)
Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings (Must use Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans / Manrope)
Full transparent overlay or dropdown containers without blur/background
Generic centered layouts with cramped cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern React (.js/.jsx) page for Organisation Profile matching Carbon Passport corporate ESG compliance design guidelines.
Ensure all key sections are populated with realistic mock enterprise data (e.g., 'EcoGlobal Logistics Corp', LEI: 5493001KJTIIGC8Y1R12, GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Operational Control boundary).
Add 'Edit Organisation Profile' modal with functional state allowing users to update fields and see changes dynamically updated.
Include a filterable or readable Audit Trail log at the bottom showing immutable record edits.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, status badges, and table rows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic Inter or Space Grotesk font for main headings
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format
Use Sonner for toasts when profile editing is saved
Ensure high contrast in both light and dark modes according to APCA/WCAG rules
